test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Simplify the given expression.

(1 - 2x)² - (1 + 2x)²
solution:
**Formula Used:**

a² -b² = (a + b)(a - b)

**Calculation:**

(1 - 2x)² - (1 + 2x)²

⇒ (1 - 2x + 1 + 2x)(1 - 2x - 1 - 2x)

⇒ (2)(-4x)

⇒ -8x

**∴ The value of (1 - 2x)2 - (1 + 2x)2 is -8x.**
